summary: This is an 8-K filed by World Omni Auto Receivables LLC as depositor for a securitization transaction. On August 26, 2026, the issuing entity World Omni Auto Receivables Trust 2026-C issued $1,011,080,000 in asset-backed notes across Classes A-1 through C, backed by motor vehicle retail installment sale contracts. The filing includes the amended trust agreement, receivables purchase agreement, sale and servicing agreement, indenture, and administration agreement. This is a routine securitization closing, not a special situation. No acquisition, tender, spin-off, or other corporate event is present; the registrant's role is issuer of securities in a structured finance transaction.
